phase_detail: CBA still in force; owners expected to lock out players when it expires
headline: Owners tabled a revised hard cap starting in 2028, the union rejected it, and a lockout after Dec. 1 is still widely expected.
latest: The Wall Street Journal reported that MLB has prepared for a possible union move to disclaim interest during a lockout, which would end the MLBPA's role as bargaining agent. No bargaining sessions or new proposals have been reported.
next_milestone: Owners meetings and qualifying offer deadline
